cases.description: Find the project-classpath JARs containing org.slf4j.Logger

shell.command:
cd "$PROJECT_PATH" || exit 1; MVN=mvn; [ -x ./mvnw ] && MVN=./mvnw; cp=$("$MVN" --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --offline ${MAVEN_EXECUTION_REPO_PATH:+-Dmaven.repo.local="$MAVEN_EXECUTION_REPO_PATH"} dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.includeScope=test) || exit 1; printf '%s
' "$cp" | awk '/Dependencies classpath:/ {getline; print}' | tr ':' '
' | grep -v '^$' | while IFS= read -r jar; do case "$jar" in *.jar) ;; *) continue ;; esac; entries=$(unzip -Z1 "$jar") || exit 1; if printf '%s
' "$entries" | grep -qi 'org/slf4j/logger.*\.class$'; then printf '%s
' "$jar"; fi; done

cases.description: List the slf4j-api versions on the project classpath

shell.command: cd "$PROJECT_PATH" || exit 1; MVN=mvn; [ -x ./mvnw ] && MVN=./mvnw; cp=$("$MVN" --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --offline ${MAVEN_EXECUTION_REPO_PATH:+-Dmaven.repo.local="$MAVEN_EXECUTION_REPO_PATH"} dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.includeScope=test) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$cp" | awk '/Dependencies classpath:/ {getline; print}' | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^$' | while IFS= read -r jar; do case "$jar" in */org/slf4j/slf4j-api/*/slf4j-api-*.jar) basename "$(dirname "$jar")" ;; esac; done

cases.description: Read org.slf4j.Logger from the sources JARs of the project classpath

shell.command:
cd "$PROJECT_PATH" || exit 1; MVN=mvn; [ -x ./mvnw ] && MVN=./mvnw; cp=$("$MVN" --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress --offline ${MAVEN_EXECUTION_REPO_PATH:+-Dmaven.repo.local="$MAVEN_EXECUTION_REPO_PATH"} dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.includeScope=test) || exit 1; printf '%s
' "$cp" | awk '/Dependencies classpath:/ {getline; print}' | tr ':' '
' | grep -v '^$' | while IFS= read -r jar; do src="${jar%.jar}-sources.jar"; if [ -f "$src" ]; then entries=$(unzip -Z1 "$src") || exit 1; if printf '%s
' "$entries" | grep -qx 'org/slf4j/Logger.java'; then unzip -p "$src" org/slf4j/Logger.java || exit 1; fi; fi; done
